description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React app by creating a root and rendering the App component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for the React application in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
